description: Implement a TPC-DS-OBT benchmark that collapses all TPC-DS sales + returns + needed attributes into ONE truly wide table. The benchmark must output only one table (e.g., `tpcds_sales_returns_obt`) that merges store/web/catalog sales and returns, embeds any dimension attributes inline, and is the sole table referenced by the adapted queries. No auxiliary dimension tables are part of the benchmark.
